qualifier: receptor cargo sorted via multivesicular bodies
name: Ubiquitin-dependent receptor endocytosis and multivesicular body sorting
rationale: All members concern ubiquitin-tagged internalisation of surface receptors (EGFR, MET hijacked by Listeria InlB) and their MVB sorting to degradation, whereas confusables cover ESCRT machinery, viral budding or Mtb host manipulation.

qualifier: sinoatrial pacemaking and gap-junction coupling
name: Sinoatrial pacemaking and electrical coupling in cardiac conduction
rationale: Members regulate cardiac impulse conduction via HCN-driven SA node depolarisation and gap-junction cell coupling, distinguishing them from conduction-system development and working-myocyte or AV-node depolarisation confusables.

qualifier: type II (SLC34) cotransporters and their disorders
name: Type II sodium-phosphate cotransporters and phosphate homeostasis
rationale: Every member concerns SLC34 type II Na+/Pi cotransporters, their regulation and the diseases of their defects, unlike confusables centred on SLC20 mineralisation or bicarbonate/anion exchangers.

qualifier: collateral sprouting
name: Axon regeneration and collateral sprouting
rationale: All members concern regrowth or sprouting of existing axons after injury or in its absence, while confusables cover developmental axon guidance and semaphorin/netrin repulsion.

qualifier: de novo head-group synthesis, cardiolipin and membrane transfer
name: De novo glycerophospholipid and cardiolipin synthesis and transfer
rationale: Members cover synthesis of PC, PE, PS, PI, PG and cardiolipin, lysophospholipid hydrolysis and intermembrane phospholipid transfer, whereas confusables emphasise acyl-chain remodelling of other classes, sphingolipids or endocannabinoids.

qualifier: PML body and oncogene-induced senescence
name: Nuclear protein shuttling regulation and PML-associated senescence
rationale: Members regulate nuclear import/export and DNA binding together with PML body organisation, arsenite response and oncogene-induced senescence/SAHF, which separates them from SUMOylation, p53 and nuclear pore/RNA export confusables.

qualifier: amino sugar, sialic acid and lysosomal glycan catabolism
name: Amino sugar, sialic acid and lysosomal glycoconjugate metabolism
rationale: Members span amino-sugar and sialic acid synthesis, N-glycan and glycosphingolipid processing and their lysosomal catabolism (HEXA/HEXB, NEU1, Salla), while confusables centre on nucleotide-sugar transport, O-glycans, fucose or GPI synthesis.

qualifier: male copulation and uterine contraction in parturition
name: Male copulatory function and uterine contraction in parturition
rationale: All members are reproductive acts (mating behaviour, erection, insemination, parturition with uterine contraction), unlike confusables built on female, parental, aggressive or sleep behaviours.

qualifier: galactose, fructose, pentose and polyol routes with inborn errors
name: Galactose, fructose, pentose and polyol metabolism
rationale: Members cover the Leloir pathway, fructose and pentose/xylulose metabolism, non-oxidative pentose phosphate shunt and alditols with their deficiencies, distinct from glycolysis/glycogen and disaccharide digestion confusables.

qualifier: positive regulation, fusion and skeletal muscle regeneration
name: Promotion of myoblast differentiation, fusion and muscle regeneration
rationale: All members promote myoblast commitment, differentiation and fusion including satellite-cell-driven regeneration, whereas confusables add myoblast proliferation, migration and negative regulation.

qualifier: proton-coupled oligopeptide and neutral/aromatic amino acids
name: Proton-coupled oligopeptide and neutral amino acid import
rationale: Members are proton/oligopeptide cotransport plus histidine, alanine, glutamine and branched-chain/aromatic amino acid import, unlike confusables focused on proline/glycine, cationic amino acids or polyamines.

qualifier: responses to replication-blocking drugs
name: Responses to replication-blocking drugs and DNA-protein crosslinks
rationale: All three members concern repair of protein-DNA adducts such as trapped topoisomerase (camptothecin) and hydroxyurea-induced replication stress, distinct from ADP-ribosylation, Fanconi and double-strand break confusables.

qualifier: protein stability and antitumor T cell response
name: PD-L1 stability control and antitumor T cell response
rationale: Members describe PD-L1 glycosylation, trafficking and degradation routes plus regulation of T cell responses to tumour cells, unlike neddylation, proteasome or Nef/Vpu downregulation confusables.

qualifier: mRNA turnover and mitoribosome biogenesis
name: Mitochondrial mRNA turnover and mitoribosome biogenesis
rationale: Members concern mitochondrial mRNA stability, modification and decay, rRNA modification, mitoribosome assembly and translation, whereas confusables cover mitochondrial tRNA processing, mtDNA replication/transcription or pseudouridylation.

qualifier: ERK dephosphorylation and negative feedback
name: ERK dephosphorylation and negative feedback on MAPK signaling
rationale: Members describe phosphatase-mediated inactivation of ERK and feedback suppression of the MAPK cascade with Ser/Thr/Tyr phosphorylation control, distinct from AP-1/IL-6, JNK/p38 or ERK5/atypical MAPK confusables.

qualifier: MHC class II and CD1 lipid antigens
name: MHC class II and CD1 lipid antigen presentation
rationale: Members cover exogenous peptide loading on MHC class II, B cell and DC antigen-presentation modules and CD1 lipid antigen presentation, unlike MHC class I, proteasome or NKT confusables.

qualifier: heme scavenging/transport and iron uptake responses
name: Heme scavenging, transport and iron homeostasis responses
rationale: Members concern plasma heme scavenging and transport, iron import and responses to iron, oxygen and redox status, while confusables add heme biosynthesis, transferrin cycling, vitamin C or other metals.

qualifier: Rab and Arf GTPase regulation and vesicle tethering
name: Rab and Arf GTPase regulation of Golgi organization
rationale: Members cover Golgi assembly, disassembly and ribbon formation with Rab GEF/GAP activity, Rab geranylgeranylation, Arf signalling and vesicle tethering, whereas confusables centre on COPI/COPII vesicle traffic and endosomal transport.

qualifier: calcitonin-, amylin- and glucagon-family receptors
name: Calcitonin- and glucagon-family peptide receptor cAMP signaling
rationale: Members are calcitonin/CGRP/amylin and glucagon-type receptor signalling with somatostatin and adenylate cyclase/cAMP control, unlike nutrient-sensing GPCR and insulin secretion confusables.

qualifier: carnitine shuttle and transporter defects
name: Fatty acid and carnitine transport for beta-oxidation
rationale: Members concern carnitine shuttle, carnitine and fatty acid transporters (including blood-brain barrier transport and transporter deficiencies) feeding beta-oxidation, while confusables cover the oxidation steps themselves and ketone bodies.

qualifier: PLK1, Aurora A and NEK kinase control
name: PLK1, Aurora A and NEK kinases in mitotic entry
rationale: Members describe PLK1, Aurora A and NEK9/6/7 regulation of G2/M entry, centrosome separation and spindle formation, distinct from spindle checkpoint, midzone and centrosome-maturation confusables.

qualifier: joint morphogenesis and endochondral ossification
name: Chondrocyte differentiation, joint formation and endochondral ossification
rationale: Members cover chondrocyte proliferation, differentiation and hypertrophy, cartilage and joint morphogenesis and replacement ossification, unlike osteoblast and direct ossification confusables.

qualifier: lysis, agglutination and metal sequestration against Gram-positive bacteria
name: Mucosal antibacterial lysis, agglutination and metal sequestration
rationale: Members describe innate mucosal defence against bacteria through peptidoglycan-targeting cytolysis, agglutination, epithelial attachment and nutritional metal sequestration, while confusables focus on defensins, neutrophil killing or antifungal responses.

qualifier: multiciliogenesis, mucociliary clearance and CSF flow
name: Motile cilium assembly, multiciliogenesis and ciliary fluid clearance
rationale: Members cover axonemal dynein arm and central apparatus assembly, multiciliated cell differentiation, mucociliary clearance and CSF circulation, unlike sperm motility, left-right asymmetry or tubulin modification confusables.

qualifier: hexosamine, sialic acid and nucleotide-sugar donor synthesis
name: Hexosamine, sialic acid and nucleotide-sugar donor metabolism
rationale: Members concern UDP-GlcNAc synthesis via GFPT1, sialic acid/CMP-Neu5Ac and dolichol-glucose donor metabolism, whereas confusables cover nucleotide-sugar transport, N-glycan processing/lysosomal catabolism or O-glycan elaboration.
